name: @newio/cli
description: Newio CLI and daemon — headless agent management
//publishConfig: @newio/cli ships ONLY the `newio` binary to npm. The library export (DaemonConnector etc.) exists for the in-workspace Electron connector and is intentionally NOT importable from the published package: `exports` is stripped so the internal agent-engine/agent-sdk code bundled into the binary cannot be reached via `import '@newio/cli'`.
//optionalDependencies: sharp powers image blurhash/dimension metadata on media upload and is optional — the CLI degrades gracefully without it. On `npm i -g` npm fetches the matching @img/* prebuild for the user's platform; the SEA build instead ships sharp's runtime closure as a sidecar dir next to the binary (see scripts/build-*-sea*). blurhash (pure JS) is a regular runtime dependency: external + npm-installed for the npm build, bundled into the binary for the SEA build (which has no node_modules).
